_readme: Labelled examples for the News tab's filters. Each is a headline as a feed would send it, with the verdict a hotel sales reader would want: 'keep' (a single real story) or 'drop' (junk). body: 'prose' = a normal article paragraph, 'short' = about 20 words, 'none' = the feed sent no text, 'headlines' = a run of headline fragments, or literal text. source: 'default', 'appointments' (a feed flagged dropAppointments) or 'titleOnly' (a feed that only sends titles). Add a case here whenever a bad story gets through or a good one is dropped.
